item.title: The numbers remain undeniable when it comes to Heat’s Bam boost; Wiggins again out
item.description: Scour recent Miami Heat social media these days and numbers are offered that make you take pause when it comes to center Bam Adebayo.

item.title: Pedestrian fatally struck by Brightline train in Fort Lauderdale north of downtown station
item.description: A pedestrian was struck and killed by a Brightline in Fort Lauderdale near North Andrews Avenue early Sunday, officials confirmed.

item.title: Dolphins’ first roster under new GM Sullivan to take shape with start of free agency
item.description: The Dolphins will begin to construct their roster for their first season under new GM Jon-Eric Sullivan as free agency opens this week.

item.title: Officials say 3 arrested in Peru nightclub bombing as number of injured rises to 44
item.description: The explosion occurred early Saturday at the Dalí nightclub in the city of Trujillo in La Libertad region, which has the largest gold-producing area in Peru and is rife with extortion and illegal mining.

item.title: Counterprotester throws improvised explosive at anti-Islam event in NYC, police say
item.description: Two people were in custody for their alleged role in the confrontation, which unfolded during a “Stop the Islamic Takeover of New York City” event led by the far right activist Jake Lang outside the Manhattan residence of Mayor Zohran Mamdani.

item.title: Iranian state TV says Mojtaba Khamenei, son of the late supreme leader, has been named his successor
item.description: The younger Khamenei, 56, had long been considered a contender for the post, even before an Israeli strike killed the 86-year-old Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Crude oil prices surpass $100 a barrel as the Iran war impedes production and shipping
item.description: By ALEX VEIGA CHICAGO (AP) — Oil prices have eclipsed $100 per barrel for the first time in more than three and a half years as the Iran war hinders production and shipping in the Middle East.
